name: evidence-lab-meeting-capture
description: Turn Evidence Lab meeting transcripts or notes into source-bounded summaries and register each completed summary in the canonical Notion meeting database.

interface.shortDescription: Capture an Evidence Lab meeting in the canonical register.
interface.longDescription: Produces a source-bounded meeting summary, preserves decisions and open questions, writes the page into the canonical Notion meeting register, and verifies the stored record.
interface.defaultPrompt: Summarize this Evidence Lab meeting and save the verified note in the canonical meeting register.
